title: Watch Codex companion: frosted sessions proposal

native.implementation: SwiftUI; semantic Dynamic Type styles, SF Symbols and native navigation. Values below are observed implementation literals; watchAccent is an explicit shared Watch constant.
native.units: points; typography uses semantic styles rather than fixed sizes

accent.usage: Adaptive asset retained on iPhone; Watch uses explicit watchAccent instead.

colors.watchCanvas: LinearGradient: black, watchAccent.opacity(0.16), black; topLeading to bottomTrailing; ignoresSafeArea
colors.error: Color.red; destructive controls use the native destructive role

watchAccent.application: Direct running-status references and WatchApp .tint(watchAccent).accentColor(watchAccent), with forced dark colorScheme; also used at 16% opacity in the backdrop gradient.

colors.phoneSecondaryCopy: Color.primary.opacity(0.65); tertiary chevrons and existing semantic detail-state/count styles unchanged

typography.family: system; no custom fonts or fixed line heights

native.depth: Native translucent materials, blurred color backdrops and half-point white edge highlights; no custom shadows.
native.motion: Native system behavior; no custom animation tokens.
native.layout: Content-sized vertical scroll views; no fixed breakpoint system. Watch uses snapshot order; iPhone groups running sessions first. PhoneActiveSession uses AnyLayout with leading VStackLayout(spacing: 8) at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes, HStackLayout and Spacer(minLength: 8) otherwise.
native.documentationScope: Current local glass-proposal SwiftUI sources only; unpublished, not simulator-verified. No HTML/CSS approximations or fixed font metrics.
native.verification: Local proposal only; no simulator verification or final visual, accessibility or contrast QA pass claimed. Fresh builds, protocol tests and rendered-device inspection remain required.
native.compatibility: Native materials supported by Xcode 16.4 and project targets; materials available on iOS 15+ and watchOS 10+. No glassEffect: it requires SDK 26. The iOS 27 reference is visual direction only.

components.name: Watch session row
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Cyan running status and headline title; quieter medium subheadline title for other sessions. All rows use ultraThinMaterial, 12-point inset, 18-point continuous corners and a 0.5-point white edge at 14% opacity. Two-line title; one-line project. Combined accessibility children with state value.

components.name: iPhone active session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Title2 bold title, accent status/action, primary-at-65%-opacity project and up-to-three-line summary. UltraThinMaterial; 22-point inset; 24-point continuous corner; 0.5-point white edge at 30% opacity. Header stacks vertically with 8-point spacing at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes. Combined accessibility children.

components.name: iPhone recent session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink, native status symbol, headline title, project and state in primary at 65% opacity, tertiary chevron. No card fill. 15-point vertical padding; inset dividers between rows.

components.name: Native navigation
components.description: NavigationStack and NavigationLink; watch inline Codex title, iPhone native large root title and inline detail titles. Receipts and diagnostics remain below sessions or on connection screens.

components.name: Native actions
components.description: Watch bordered refresh/source controls with minimum height 44 and explicit accessibility labels; iPhone toolbar refresh and pull-to-refresh. Refresh disables while busy. Stop uses native destructive role and confirmationDialog.

components.name: Demo instruction field
components.description: Native TextField in List sections; watch system keyboard/dictation, iPhone multiline range 3...8. 2000-character limit with red error/count; preserve draft. Send disabled for unavailable mutation, running thread, blank or oversized input.

components.name: iPhone Watch connection card
components.description: Plain NavigationLink with native Watch symbol, reachability label and tertiary chevron. ThinMaterial; 16-point inset and continuous corner; 0.5-point white edge at 22% opacity. Device reachability is not Remote authorization.

narrative.overview: Unpublished native frosted-glass proposal for the existing session-first Watch and iPhone demo. Translucent materials and restrained color backdrops support clear session hierarchy without implying a real Remote connection.
keyCharacteristics: Running-session emphasis and quieter recent sessions
Native frosted materials and restrained color backdrops
dos: Keep every session and action explicitly simulated.
Keep device reachability distinct from Remote authentication.
Use semantic Dynamic Type and native controls.
Use explicit watchAccent for Watch tint and running status; preserve clear demo/disconnected disclosure and check rendered contrast over materials.
donts: Do not claim this local proposal is shipped, simulator-verified or implemented with glassEffect.
Do not fabricate progress percentages, login state, host status, completion or live Remote connection.
Do not add a giant disconnected card ahead of the sessions.
